diffs.diff: maximum supply: part 5.5 V, datasheet reading 5 V
diffs.evidence: The model is the GY-21 HTU21D module (VIN feeds an on-board 3.3 V regulator), not the bare chip. The ProtoSupplies GY-21 HTU21D product page, under Technical Specifications > Maximum Ratings, says: 'Vcc Range 3.3 to 5.5V'. It also says 'The backside of the module mounts a 3.3V regulator and level shifting MOSFET transistors to make the module compatible with both 3.3V and 5V MCUs.' The second reading's 5 V comes from the page's informal wiring text ('Connect Vin to 3-5VDC to match MCU'), which describes typical MCU logic levels, not the maximum rating. vmax 5.5 V for VIN is correct. The bare chip's 3.6 V limit, which does not apply to VIN, is already documented separately.
